items.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: I studied with Kenny Davern when I was in college, and he is one of the masters of the note benders

ctx.x: I heard you doing some mean bending of notes in that last set that I thought was very interesting.
Yeah with it’s, stylistically, things borrowed from other people. I studied with Kenny Davern when I was in college, and he is one of the masters of the note benders, let’s put it that way.
He’s almost the standard of how people get measured these days.
